concept: Noticing and appreciating the plants, animals, and outdoor spaces around you
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character slows down outside and notices something in nature they'd never really looked at before
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the character notice that they'd walked past before without seeing?
exercise.practice: Student names one thing in nature near them that they'd like to look at more closely

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, real thing they'd want to observe
